option_relations.rationale: The patient's presentation of pink-purple dermal papules, polyarticular inflammatory arthritis, and lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with atypical lymphocytes, along with the immunophenotypic profile of CD8-positive lymphocytes, matches the characteristics of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, CD8+ variant, which is equivalent to Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma.
Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, does not match the specific characteristics of the patient's presentation and immunophenotypic profile.
